name: PDE5 inhibitors
summary: PDE5 inhibitors are medicines that include sildenafil and tadalafil, used mainly for erection problems. Some are also used for pulmonary hypertension. The NHS warns against combining them with nitrates and poppers because blood pressure can fall sharply.
mechanism: StatPearls says these drugs stop the PDE5 enzyme from breaking down cGMP, a chemical messenger. StatPearls also says nitrates and PDE5 inhibitors both cause blood vessels to widen, so using them together can cause severe low blood pressure.
classEffects: Headache, indigestion and a blocked nose are among the side effects the NHS lists for sildenafil and tadalafil.
A painful or prolonged erection and sudden changes in sight or hearing are listed as serious.
cautions: StatPearls says combining PDE5 inhibitors with nitrates is contraindicated because of the risk of profound and potentially life-threatening low blood pressure.
The NHS lists poppers and some illegal drugs as raising the risk of serious side effects.
A recent heart attack or stroke is among the reasons the NHS lists against use of sildenafil and tadalafil.
A review says alpha-blockers call for caution with PDE5 inhibitors.

classWarnings.text: Combining a PDE5 inhibitor with nitrates can cause a dangerous fall in blood pressure.

classWarnings.text: Sudden loss of vision or hearing needs a call to a doctor right away.

classInteractions.effect: A dangerous fall in blood pressure; the NHS says sildenafil is not usually prescribed with nitrates, and the same warning applies to tadalafil.

classInteractions.effect: A higher risk of serious side effects.

classInteractions.with: Illegal drugs such as amphetamines, ecstasy and cocaine
classInteractions.effect: The NHS says these can increase the risk of serious side effects.
